principles: conservative qualification budgets; not chosen to maximize success rate
one shared budget for paired lanes (A==B, C==D) unless a harness requires a documented fixed overhead
budgets never silently extend; exhaustion produces a truthful BLOCKED_OR_DEGRADED_TRUTHFULLY result
evidence limits never silently truncate required proof; if evidence cannot be fully recorded the run cannot become COMPLETED_VERIFIED
host_basis: Dell source-server: Intel i7-6700 8 logical CPUs, ~11 GiB RAM free, 4 GiB swap; proven build profile 1-6 GiB containers, 8 CPUs

inactivity_timeout_seconds.rationale: event-stream silence bound; aborts hung tasks well under total timeout

max_descendant_processes.rationale: cgroup TasksMax; coding tasks are tool-light; prevents fork bombs

cpu_quota_percent.rationale: 4 of 8 CPUs; leaves headroom for host + reviewer/verifier

memory_ceiling_bytes.rationale: 6 GiB cgroup MemoryMax; below host free RAM; below historical OOM threshold

file_size_limit_bytes.rationale: 10 MiB per file; coding fixtures are small

max_open_files.rationale: host open-files default; sufficient for bounded tasks

max_model_requests.rationale: turn_budget 4 with at most 1 retry; conservative for single-task qualification

max_consecutive_malformed_responses.rationale: fail closed after repeated malformed model output

max_streaming_inactivity_seconds.rationale: below inactivity timeout; aborts stalled streams

max_tool_calls.rationale: bounded agent loop; generous for read/edit cycles, tight against runaway

max_shell_commands.rationale: command_policy no_shell; bash denied; shell commands forbidden

max_file_writes.rationale: bounded edit surface for small tasks

max_deleted_files.rationale: deletion denied in qualification; diff contract records zero deletes by policy

max_ndjson_line_length_bytes.rationale: 256 KiB; comfortably above any single event, rejects oversized

max_event_count.rationale: well above bounded-task event volume; bounds parser/memory

controlled_tests_required: each limit has a test that triggers exhaustion and asserts BLOCKED_OR_DEGRADED_TRUTHFULLY (never COMPLETED_VERIFIED)
